name: Google Sheets MCP Server
description: Provides a secure bridge for AI assistants to interact with the Google Sheets API via 31 tools for spreadsheet management, data manipulation, and table-level operations. It supports both Service Account and OAuth 2.0 authentication for tasks including batch updates, CSV imports, and conditional formatting.
